name: omnilab/inaturalist
description: Omnilab iNaturalist: a taxon of iNaturalist by its id or a name it matches - its rank, common name in a language, iconic group, IUCN status, lineage, Wikipedia summary, observation count, default photo with its licence and attribution, its parent as a related thing - a search of its names, and the observations of a place and a period (research grade by default; by taxon, licence, quality grade), each with its time and place, its taxon related and its licence, through the iNaturalist API (v1 for taxa, v2 for observations), no key needed.
